text:
maya-cs: quick heads-up — VelvetApp reporting init 429s right after onboarding. traffic is low but they say each worker spins up 6-8 short-lived SDK clients at boot (50 workers). token exchange looks fine, errors come from preflight/gateway.
ajay (cs-eng): do we have their SDK version and platform? could be preflight fanout. ask for init logs and sample request headers.
maya-cs: they sent logs: ```2026-03-08T15:22:01Z velvet-worker-3 init: POST /v1/embeddings 429 
Response: {"error":"rate_limited","message":"preflight limit"}``` also noted HTTP/1.1 per-request new connections, no keepalive.
carla-sre: that pattern screams connection storm hitting sdkgateway per-ip conn limiter. gateway enforces max concurrent sockets per source NAT to protect backend. if all workers share node IPs, small QPS but high concurrency can trigger 429s.
ajay (cs-eng): quick remediation path: 1) enable connection reuse (keepAlive or HTTP/2) in their SDK clients 2) add jitter/stagger to worker boot to avoid synchronized warmups 3) temporary: raise per-ip conn limit for VelvetApp while they roll out fix. maya, can ops raise the limit?
maya-cs: pinging ops — @carla-sre can you bump VelvetApp tenant to 200 concurrent conns for 24–48h? Also sending customer a Node snippet to enable keepAlive: ```js
const https = require('https');
const agent = new https.Agent({ keepAlive: true, maxSockets: 16 });
fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings', { method: 'POST', body, agent });
```
(we suggested HTTP/2 if their infra supports multiplexing).
carla-sre: increased tenant conn limit to 200 at 15:29 UTC and added an alert rule to highlight sustained conn spikes from that tenant. :white_check_mark:
velvet-eng: thanks — we enabled keepAlive and switched our init path to HTTP/2. initial boot that previously had ~60 429s now shows 0. will monitor for 24h and report.
ajay (cs-eng): perfect. follow-up actions: add keepAlive/HTTP2 snippet to onboarding quickstart, add note in account health checklist to watch conn spikes during ramp.
maya-cs: noted, i'll update onboarding checklist and create a docs PR with the snippet. will close this thread after 24h stable. :tada:
